decision_needed: Founder decision needed to obtain a model run: either (a) allow outbound access to huggingface.co and its CDN hosts in the environment network policy so a small instruct model can be downloaded and served locally, (b) point AP_OLLAMA_BASE_URL at an approved OpenAI-compatible endpoint, or (c) approve a capped paid key via NASHA_ALLOW_PAID_MODEL=1 (not used by default).
